_doc: Config for CombyCode/quality-gate. Lives HERE, not with the engine: it describes THIS library's API and must change when the API does. Run: bun run gate
_receivers: The name used in prose -> the class(es) it means. Class names, not file paths: moving a declaration between files is not an API change.
_claims: Every cited sha and path must resolve. `extra` reaches the update reports, which live outside the library but cite ITS commits. Versions are deliberately out of scope here (third-party versions look identical to ours) — that is G7's question.
_consumerInstall: Installs the PACKED tarball, never a directory link: a file: dep on the source dir can be symlinked, walking past the files filter and exports map. Typecheck is the free tier; the LIVE run of consumers/feature is what proves behaviour and stays a human step.
_exampleRuns: G12. The only check that EXECUTES. Everything else reads: types, references, snapshots, compilation — all of which passed while the library sent OpenAI a tool schema the API rejects with a 400. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment; without them it reports cannot-judge (exit 2), never a pass. The runs are chosen for surfaces the WIRE can reject: function tools, structured output, and real MCP schemas, on both providers.

exampleRuns._runs: The first two runs are the ones with teeth. A run set chosen by SURFACE (tools, structured, MCP) missed the strict bug entirely, because every example declared its tool parameters as required — the defect only appears on a shape no example used. Choose these by SHAPE.
exampleRuns._waived: Every waiver here says the same thing, and it is the honest thing: these have not been triaged for live running yet. They are listed rather than ignored so the unexecuted set stays countable and shrinks on purpose. Replacing a line here with a `runs` entry is the unit of progress.
